card.title: 25 POUNDER
card.flavorText: The Ordnance QF 25-pounder, or also called 25 pounder or 25-pdr, was the major British field gun and howitzer used during WWII and in later conflicts. It was introduced just before the war started, combining high-angle and direct-fire, relatively high rates of fire, and a reasonably lethal shell in a highly mobile piece.
